reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Discordance discovery, orthogonal paired imaging and sorted-population kinetic/transfer follow-up.

checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult and transfer prior primary Methods or validated protocols before execution. Calibration alone is not this action.
Essential stimulation, sampling, staining and preparation settings are deferred; no quantitative source/calibration-to-setting procedure makes the primary workflow executable.
Correct independent biological units and a pilot are recognized, but no quantitative power or precision target connects meaningful effect and pilot variation to a confirmatory sample size.
Model families and contrasts are named but the primary likelihood/assumptions, diagnostics and multiplicity procedure remain unspecified.
Technical repair does not explicitly require a revised frozen procedure and fresh independent confirmatory data after changes.
No complete immutable input manifest, exact software/environment/settings and command-to-output provenance chain is specified.
No clean-environment rerun with numerical figure outputs, declared tolerances, resource/failure logs and source-difference audit is planned.

checks.quote: Culture sorted P+R− and P+R+ cells separately.
checks.reason: The answer correctly admits that live sorting cannot gate these RNA states, then repeatedly requires separately cultured/reprofiled RNA-defined populations without a validated live proxy. Destructive joint profiling or FISH cannot supply those recoverable cells.

Surface strippability and failure to recover are not unique to transferred protein: endogenous long-lived surface protein without ongoing synthesis can behave likewise. The proposed transfer experiment can establish transfer capability, not uniquely assign every ex vivo discordance to it.

checks.quote: the correct "integration" is a noise model
checks.reason: Failure of the selected discordant markers does not identify a uniquely correct integration strategy or justify treating all observed discrepancies as artifacts; this exceeds the tested marker-specific validation.

The fitted detection/background probabilities do not identify a separable technical fraction for every heterogeneous biological cell. Subtracting that fraction and assigning per-cell mechanism ground truth requires a calibrated mixture/identifiability model that is absent.

A negative smFISH result with positive controls constrains abundance at its detection limit, not literal absence. The declared real-state/mechanism decisions omit an explicit uncertainty bound on the negative measurement.
No donor-disjoint discovery/tuning/confirmation split with all fitting inside training units is specified; focal populations are selected and promoted to ground truth on the discovery donors.

checks.quote: the mixed model absorbs run effects
checks.reason: A random run effect does not resolve donor-by-day confounding. The troubleshooting instruction lacks a balanced independent repeat for that confound and can mistake unidentifiable run/biology differences for corrected signal.
A tractable proposed PBMC system, panel and biological hypotheses are specified; new data are not claimed. Scope and assumptions are visible and answer length is within the limit.

explanation_reason: Useful orthogonal validation, but nonrecoverable RNA-defined live groups, overidentified mechanisms and unvalidated ground-truth decomposition undermine several conclusions.
historical_match_reason: The biological value of complementary RNA/protein measurements is recognized, but the chosen direction is discordance kinetics and mechanism. It does not propose local cell-specific predictive modality weights, adaptive multimodal neighborhoods, a matched single/fixed/adaptive comparison or the corresponding held-out integration gain. A valid alternative biological study earns scientific credit, not the sealed integration-direction hit.
